resources.string: Keeps Cabin Play connected to this phone
Enter the address and code the cabin’s Phone app shows while no phone is connected. The link stays on while this service runs; the phone can sleep.
The code from the Phone app
Notification access: not granted. Android 13+ sideloaded apps may need “Allow restricted settings” in App info first.
Contacts: not granted — the cab can’t show or search them.
Call state: granted, answer/end: not granted
Call state and answer/end: not granted

Notifications, battery, contacts and call state for now. Call audio cannot be captured by third-party apps; calls stay on the phone. SMS comes later. The link is token-gated and private-network-only, not encrypted: use it on a trusted home network.
Fill in the address, the port and the code.
